{{Quote|To Ilum we must go.|[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]|audio=ToIlumWeMustGo-CW14.flac|<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 14">{{CW|14}}</ref>}}
'''Ilum''' was an [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], one of the main sources of the valuable [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystals]] used in the [[Lightsaber/Legends#Construction|construction]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. The [[Crystal Cave/Legends|caverns]] containing these [[Ilum crystal/Legends|Ilum crystals]] were long ago turned into a Jedi temple. Unlike the crystals of other planets, those of Ilum were limited to blue, green, and purple in [[Color/Legends|color]]. The planet was over ninety percent-covered by ice.

==History==
===Discovery by the Jedi Order===
{{Quote|The Jedi think of Ilum as their planet. Only two of them were here when we arrived, but they have ruins scattered around the place.|Grand Moff [[Ilyan Regus|Regus]]|<ref name="Ambient" />}}
[[File:Crystal_Caves.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Entrance to the Crystal Cave]]
Ilum was first discovered by the wider galaxy in [[22,800 BBY]] when a [[Unidentified Jedi scout/Legends|Jedi scout]], navigating [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], felt a strong pull<ref name="atlas" /> from deep in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Following the sensation, the scout determined that the Force's call was strongest on the system's fifth planet.<ref name="NoP" /> Upon sighting the planet, the scout underwent a mystical experience, feeling the crust burst with kathracite, pontite, and mephite [[Adegan crystal]]s, the main power source for Jedi lightsabers.<ref name="atlas" /> However, these would later prove to be unique [[Ilum crystals]], being of such similar structure to the Adegan pontite and mephite variants that the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] would take them to be the same at first.<ref name="JATM">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref>

After the scout reported their findings back to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], the subsequent research teams detected no signs of previous inhabitants on the barren world, aside from local flora and fauna that had evolved to survive in the harsh environment. The real wealth of Ilum was not discovered until one survey crew was chased into a mountainous ravine by local predators and discovered the mother lode of [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystals]] just beneath the surface. When the High Council learned of this discovery, they dispatched [[Jedi artisan/Legends|artisans]], scholars, and other Jedi to protect the caves and research how deep they went. Instead of reporting the discovery to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] per custom, the High Council deleted all records of Ilum from their ships and removed mention of it from all reports. A team of surveyors within the Order mapped out a [[Metellos-Ilum hyperspace route/Legends|complex route]] through hyperspace from [[Metellos/Legends|Metellos]] that would take a Jedi team directly to Ilum. In order to navigate the course however, one would need the prowess in the Force that only a fully trained Master would possess.<ref name="NoP" />

With the planet protected, the Jedi built temples and enclaves over the years and the world became a destination of pilgrimage for Jedi intending to construct new lightsabers and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] seeking a quiet place for intense meditation. Over the [[Crystal Cave/Legends|greatest source of crystals]], the High Council commissioned the construction of a grand [[Jedi Temple (Ilum)/Legends|Temple]]. Upon completion, the Temple over the Crystal Caves began to host [[Gathering/Legends|the Gathering]], a formal part of a Padawan's teaching during which they embarked on a pilgrimage to Ilum to search for a lightsaber crystal and build their first weapon. After several millennia of hosting the Gathering, Ilum became the Order's primary source for the rare crystals.<ref name="NoP" /> 

Some time before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]],<ref name="TORweb-Game Setting">{{TORweb|url=info/story/setting|text=Game Setting|nolive=1}}</ref> the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] [[Raid on Ilum|attacked]] the planet with a force of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and shock troopers, [[Death/Legends|killing]] the Jedi present there. Although the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was devastated by the loss of Ilum, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] lacked the resources for a counter-attack. Intelligence suggested that the Sith operations on the world could have extended beyond the harvest of [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]] and, due to the amount of local Sith investments, Republic leaders and members of the High Council suspected that Ilum may have possessed a far more valuable resource.<ref name="galaxy-map" /><ref name="Holonet">{{Holonet|planets|ilum|Ilum}}</ref> One of the resources turned out to be a use for the crystals to power a cloaking device for spaceships, or even a whole space station. [[Darth Malgus]], taking advantage of the chaos in the Empire following the defeat of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], [[Battle of Ilum|rallied a primarily non-Human army]] and tried to establish a base in the system. Malgus' attempt was thwarted, and the cloaked armada never saw further use. The appearance of the ancient exploration vessel ''[[Gray Secant]]'' over Ilum saw both Republic and Imperial forces striving to gain influence with the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] and learn the ship's secrets, but the planet itself remained contested for the rest of the [[Galactic War]].

[[File:Ilum102.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Fortifications during the Galactic War.]]

Eventually, the Order reclaimed Ilum and once again hid its location, removing records of the battles there, which only lived on as dark legends of the past. Despite the planet's overall importance, the High Council recalled all members of the Order that were living on the planet, back to Coruscant and shuttered all facilities save the primary Temple. With no one to maintain them, most of the other Jedi installations were consumed by the planet's constant snowfall or crushed under moving glaciers.<ref name="NoP" />

===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|Jedi don't like artificial crystals anyway, not when there are such beauties on Ilum.|Quinlan Vos|<ref name="Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Ilum was the location of a [[Ambush on Ilum|Separatist ambush]]. When [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], leader of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] sent a battalion of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to the planet, the Crystal Caves were heavily damaged. Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] aided Jedi Master [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], in defending the Crystal Caves from [[Chameleon droid/Legends|chameleon droids]].<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 16">{{CW|16}}</ref> For a portion of the war, the Jedi Order decided that it was too dangerous for [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] to travel to Ilum to build their lightsabers, so shipments of lightsaber crystals were delivered to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Unduli oversaw one of the shipments aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Sedawan]]'' when it was [[Battle on the Sedawan|attacked]] by a group of [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] led by [[Sai Sircu]], who sought to pilfer the crystals to power the ''[[Devastation]]'', an [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion pulse cannon]]&ndash;equipped [[Warship/Legends|warship]] that they were building in conjunction with Dooku and the Confederacy.<ref name="Jedi Alliance">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Jedi Alliance]]''</ref>

Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Death Sentence 1">[[Darth Maul — Death Sentence 1|''Darth Maul — Death Sentence'' 1]]</ref> Yoda and Padawan [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] led a group of promising Jedi Initiates in the ritual known as [[Gathering/Legends|The Gathering]], where they would brave the dangers of the Crystal Cave and find crystals to make their own lightsabers. They used the Force to enter through a cave entrance.<ref name="TCW:TG">{{TCW|The Gathering (episode)}}</ref>

===Later history===
[[File:Ilum-TG.png|thumb|left|250px|Jedi Initiates traveling to Ilum for the Gathering.]]
Because its existence was not known generally to non-Jedi, Ilum was virtually forgotten after the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|destruction]] of the Jedi and [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] information purges. This gave the remaining Jedi a safe harbor. After [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], Obi-Wan Kenobi received intelligence that his friend, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Garen Muln]], had returned to Ilum to hide in the crystal caves. [[Ferus Olin]], a former Jedi apprentice, returned to the caves to retrieve crystals to build a new lightsaber and he also found Garen. The Jedi Master had grown weak during his time on Ilum. He gave Ferus his old lightsaber, which needed new crystals. Ferus inserted his crystals and carried the weak Jedi Master out of the caves. Obi-Wan came to their rescue before the Imperials could take them hostage. Another Jedi also took refuge there: [[Fy-Tor-Ana]]. However, according to Garen, she returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to see if any other Jedi had survived. She did not return, but it was rumored that she was imprisoned on Coruscant.

Ilum's secrecy was not to last. After scouring the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Temple Archives]] on Coruscant, the Empire swiftly moved in to seize the planet. As part of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], the [[481st Legion/Legends|481st Legion]] was dispatched to the planet to eliminate any hiding Jedi and to secure the Temple. After the Empire was fully established, the 481st was replaced with a dedicated joint forces mission of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and [[Imperial Army/Legends|Army]]. Forming up a beachhead around the Temple and installing a giant metal door over its entrance, the army constantly monitored the facility while the Navy formed a blockade around the planet. Over time, research facilities and observation platforms were established and an entire garrison was situated there. Despite the Emperor's grave concerns for the planet's safety, more often than not the posting was used as a punishment or sort of exile for delinquent officers, rival captains, and a graveyard for derelict ships. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Captain [[Malthegn]] oversaw the blockade from the command deck of the ''[[Hoplite]]''.

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Empire at War}}
During the Empire's hunt for [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kalast]], who was leaking information to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]], they discovered a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] base above Ilum. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], in the [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']], disabled their sensors so an Imperial fleet could [[Battle in the Ilum system|capture]] the pirate leader.<ref name="eaw">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''&mdash;Mission 03: Rooting Out the Pirates</ref>
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' TV series, purple crystals are seen to fall, even though it is stated to only produce blue and green crystals.

Ilum is also a planet for end-game content in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' where players can complete both PvE and PvP daily missions. Two of the game's final instances are also located there.
